messages:
maya: Quiet window 23:00 UTC tonight for targeted tf apply: tenant-fence + route cleanup. Need provider pin, canary, rollback snapshot.

deploybot: Apply window reserved: 2026-04-15 23:00 UTC. Preflight checks queued: lock, plan-hash, policy. run: https://deploy.internal/runs/0xdeaad

alex: Targets: module.tenant_fence then module.route53_cleanup. Pin provider.aws->4.28.0 and modules to staging commit.

sam: Keep TTL change conservative (300->180). Last staging DNS tweak affected some edges.

maya: Agreed. Canary plan: tenants t-700,t-701 -> 10m -> 50% -> full. Abort if auth 5xx spike >0.5% or DNS failures >1%.

deploybot: Merge freeze applied to main for window: 1779991111 -> 1779994711. Overrides require ops-lead.

ops-oncall: I'll monitor and trigger rollback on thresholds. Taking pager for 3h.

maya: Preflight checklist: snapshot state to s3://tf-state-backups/preapply-1779991111, verify plan diff, run canary. Rollback: restore snapshot and reapply prior route53 records.

alex: Plan excerpt: + aws_iam_role.tenant_api_role; ~ aws_route53_record.service ttl 300->180.

sam: Canary command: `terraform apply -target=module.tenant_fence -var='tenants=["t-700","t-701"]'` then validate.

taylor: Ops lead: GO for canary. SRE dashboards alerted.

(monitoring) deploybot: Canary apply complete. run-id 0xdeaad-canary. No errors.

ops-oncall: 10m canary checks green. Proceed to 50%.

deploybot: 50% rollout finished. run-id 0xdeaad-roll50.

alex: Logs and plan diff in run: https://deploy.internal/runs/0xdeaad/logs (access controlled).

ops-oncall: 50% stable for 15m, proceeding to full.

deploybot: Full apply complete. final-plan-hash: 0xdeaad-final.

maya: Post-apply: services healthy, DNS propagated. Releasing merge freeze in 10m. Adding note: provider pinned v4.28.0, snapshot s3://tf-state-backups/preapply-1779991111.

alex: Follow-up: automate preapply state snapshot and include link in deploy metadata.

maya: Filed ticket. Thanks all.
